question: Ustad Zakir Hussain, Ustad Allah Rakha, Ustad Sabir Khan, Pt. Kishan Maharaj are known for which of the following instruments?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tabla.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__****Ustad Zakir Hussain**

__
 
• Indian tabla player, composer, percussionist, music producer and film actor.
 
• He was awarded the **Padma Shri in 1988**, and the **Padma Bhushan in 2002,** by the** Government of India **presented by **President Abdul Kalam.**

**Ustad Allah Rakha**

 
• Indian tabla player who specialized in** Hindustani classical music.**
 
• He was a **frequent accompanist of sitar player Pandit Ravi Shankar**
 
• He was largely responsible for **introducing Tabla to the western audience**.

**Ustad Sabir Khan**

 
• **youngest** amongst the **renowned tabla players of our country.**
 
• He is the only living heir and sole representative of** Farrukhabad Gharana.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Percussion Instruments: **Tabla, Mridangam, Drum, Dholak, Cymbal, Xylophone, Ghatam, Pakhawaj, Bells
 
• **String Instruments: **Guitar, Violon, Sitar, Banjo, Sarod, Saarangi, Veena, Surbahaar, Mandolin.
 
• Wind Instruments: Flute, Clarinet, Shehnai, Saxophone Bagpipe, Harmonica, Trumpet, Piano, Harp.
